description: This file implements an HTTP-based smart turn analyzer for remote ML inference, which sends audio data to a remote HTTP endpoint for end-of-turn detection. It handles serialization of audio data, communication with the server, error handling, and prediction logic.

classes.name: HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer
classes.description: A class that performs smart turn detection via HTTP-based ML inference, sending serialized audio data to a remote endpoint and handling responses.
